promotionCandidates.title: Derive the central-mock factory registry from client test setup at rule load

evidence.note: The production rule maintains a hard-coded module-to-factory table separately from the authoritative vi.mock calls in client setup.
The drift test already reads setup.ts, parses it with the TypeScript ESLint parser, and extracts each vi.mock factory—the viable mechanism the live prior leaf says could replace the production table.
The authoritative setup explicitly requires every central mock to be copied into CANONICAL_FACTORY_SOURCES, preserving a lockstep two-file maintenance obligation.

promotionCandidates.problem: The ESLint rule duplicates every central vi.mock factory from client setup in a hard-coded registry. The bidirectional drift test detects omissions, but every central-mock addition or edit still requires a synchronized second edit, and the production rule retains a large copy of data its test already knows how to derive.
promotionCandidates.proposedDirection: Move the existing setup.ts read/parse/extract logic into rule initialization with an explicit non-throwing failure policy, then remove the hard-coded factory table and the now-redundant lockstep test. Keep the ruled-out shared data-module and config-test relocation directions closed.
